ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (dark/black) to 25% high-intensity (white/gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling concentrated in the proximal-medial region of the left lobe and the distal-lateral region of the right lobe; central area near the notch is predominantly solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration visible along both trailing edges; left lobe displays more pronounced vertical pixel-amplitude variations (jaggedness) than the right.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular high-contrast white spots (barnacle scars) localized on the inner-proximal left lobe and outer-distal right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Highly distinct dark-on-white parallel linear rake marks oriented diagonally across the distal white patch of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks on the right lobe; significant irregular trailing edge degradation on the left lobe suggesting past physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'fingerprint' pattern of three parallel vertical rake marks cutting through the white pigmentation on the distal right lobe.
